caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, box-like object with an upward-pointed triangular top. The primary color of the object is a soft blue-green, which serves as the background for floral decorations. The front of the rectangular lower section displays a bouquet consisting primarily of a large white flower, accompanied by smaller pink, red, and yellow blossoms, as well as green leaves and ferns. The triangular upper section features another bouquet at its center, with a prominent yellow rose, a pink rose, and additional small red and orange flowers, all surrounded by green leaves and some pink berries or buds. The border of the object is outlined with garlands of green leaves, brownish-orange oak leaves, and scattered bunches of small pink berries. The left side of the box is decorated with diagonal green lines and another cluster of leaves and berries. The object appears to rest on a neutral off-white background. The artist's name, Nicholas Izyupa, is signed in the lower left corner.
title: Wall Pocket
